CM Omar Abdullah Rejects PDP's Backdoor Appointment Allegations

Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has responded to allegations made by the People's Democratic Party (PDP) concerning 'backdoor appointments'. Abdullah rejected these charges, stating that the truth would be presented to the public. He used the Hindi idiom 'Ulta chor kotwal ko daante' to counter the PDP's accusations.
